description: This file contains Redux reducer functions and related utilities for managing post entities in the Mattermost application, including handling post metadata, replies, reactions, embeds, message history, and state updates for various post-related actions.

methods.name: removeUnneededMetadata
methods.description: Removes unnecessary metadata fields from a post object, such as emojis, files, reactions, acknowledgements, and cleans up embed data for opengraph and permalink types.

methods.name: nextPostsReplies
methods.description: Tracks reply counts for posts, updating state based on post received, post list, or deletion actions.

methods.name: removePostsAndEmbedsForChannels
methods.description: Removes posts and permalink embeds associated with specified channel IDs from the posts state.

methods.name: handlePosts
methods.description: Main reducer function handling various post actions, updating posts collection accordingly.

methods.name: handlePostReceived
methods.description: Processes an individual post received, updating state with new or modified post data, handling metadata, deletions, and nested permalinks.

methods.name: handlePendingPosts
methods.description: Manages the list of pending post IDs during post creation.

methods.name: postsInChannel
methods.description: Maintains ordered lists of post IDs per channel, handling new posts, updates, and deletions.

methods.name: removeNonRecentEmptyPostBlocks
methods.description: Filters out empty or non-recent post blocks.

methods.name: mergePostBlocks
methods.description: Merges overlapping or adjacent post blocks based on creation timestamps.

methods.name: mergePostOrder
methods.description: Merges two post ID arrays, removing duplicates and sorting by creation time.

methods.name: postsInThread
methods.description: Tracks comments within threads, updating on new, deleted, or removed posts.

methods.name: postEditHistory
methods.description: Stores the edit history of posts.

methods.name: currentFocusedPostId
methods.description: Tracks the currently focused post ID, e.g., in permalink view.

methods.name: reactions
methods.description: Stores reactions for posts, updating on reaction add or delete actions.

methods.name: acknowledgements
methods.description: Stores acknowledgements for posts, updating on acknowledgement add or delete actions.

methods.name: openGraph
methods.description: Stores OpenGraph metadata for link previews, updating on post embed changes.

methods.name: storeOpenGraphForPost
methods.description: Extracts and stores OpenGraph embed data from a post.

methods.name: messagesHistory
methods.description: Maintains message history for navigation, including adding, resetting, and moving through history.

methods.name: limitedViews
methods.description: Tracks message view limits for cloud plans, managing inaccessible message ranges per channel or thread.

methods.name: reducer
methods.description: Root reducer combining all post-related state slices into the overall posts state.
